GHSA-V6H2-P8H4-QCJW.67e52a58d1af8f74358d4a7980f13eb07f778787:
chore(deps): bump brace-expansion to patch DoS vulnerabilities in docs

brace-expansion@^1.1.7 (required by minimatch@3.1.5, pulled in via
eslint and eslint-plugin-react) was resolved at 1.1.15, vulnerable to
several DoS classes fixed progressively through 1.1.16-1.1.18:
unbounded expansion length causing OOM, exponential-time expansion of
consecutive non-expanding braces, and unbounded intermediate arrays
bypassing an earlier partial fix.

minimatch's own declared range (^1.1.7) already permits the patched
version; yarn's classic resolver was just reusing the older lockfile
entry rather than re-resolving it. Bumped in place to 1.1.18.

The other two brace-expansion instances in this lockfile (5.0.7,
5.0.9, an unrelated major rewrite pulled in elsewhere) were already
unaffected -- these CVEs are scoped to the 1.x line.

Fixes GHSA-v6h2-p8h4-qcjw, GHSA-xw8m-p6c8-cgvw, GHSA-3q56-9cvp-6jm7 as
flagged by Dependabot alerts #1482, #1477, #1402.

No source or docs content changed -- this is a transitive lockfile-only
version bump, so no new tests are needed; CI's docs build is the
regression check.
